answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the opal check immediately, the garden audit keeps the resolved set and the raven replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 189 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 189 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
